name: Sagane Aya
source:
[i]The honest head maid[/i]

The head maid of the Kiritani family who has served them for many years. She serves as leader of the family's several maids. Her length of service is second only to the family's butler, Yaku.

Like Sumi, she has a strict and serious personality and is also a tutor for the sisters.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/kiriya/main.html]Official Site[/url]]
